title: Rank 2 cyclic Z2 semion row resolved as partial low-rank ribbon progress
top_notice: The rank2-cyclic-z2 family row now has two exact semion/anti-semion ribbon realization snapshots with explicit nontrivial associator omega(1,1,1)=-1. The low-rank ribbon catalog remains partial: 4 rows resolved, 10 rows blocked, and formal scan-plan generation is still disabled.
validated_behaviors: The rank2 cyclic Z2 semion snapshots record omega(1,1,1)=-1 rather than pretending the associator is strict.
The exact Z2 checks pass pentagon, left and right hexagon, ribbon square, monodromy nondegeneracy, and twist/R compatibility.
The strict-associator semion negative control fails both left and right hexagon, preventing the previous silent-fail route.
The two rank2 cyclic Z2 snapshots pass validate_formal_evidence.
The v5 catalog passes validate_low_rank_ribbon_catalog as PARTIAL_RIBBON_REFINEMENT_PROGRESS.
The v5 readiness artifact keeps scan_plan_generation_allowed=false.

explicit_non_claims: This note does not claim FORMAL_LOW_RANK_SCAN_COMPLETE.
